family_name: Higgins Insulation Higgins Foil Non Breather Medium Duty

spec.description:
Foil Wall Wrap Non Breather is a medium-duty, five-layer
reflective foil building membrane featuring bright aluminum foil tested to 97%
reflectivity adhered to one side. Engineered as a complete vapor and moisture
barrier for external walls, it creates an impermeable radiant barrier when
installed with an adjacent air gap of at least 20mm. Constructed with
UV-stabilized woven polypropylene, it delivers exceptional tear resistance
during installation on exposed residential and commercial frames in warmer and
tropical climate zones.
features:
Five-layer heavy-duty composite with
UV-stabilized woven polypropylene substrate

Pure bright aluminum foil facing
tested to 97% radiant reflectivity

Impermeable non-breather vapor barrier

Medium Duty classification
resisting high wind tears and punctures on site

Corona-treated substrate for
superior lamination bonding

Protects building frames from moisture
penetration, draughts, and dust

Manufactured in Australia compliant with
Australian fire standard AS 1530

Generous 1350mm x 60m roll size providing 81
m² of continuous coverage

install:
Fix horizontally across the outside face of
wall framing studs starting from the bottom plate

Fasten with galvanized
clouts or staples at maximum 300mm centers to studs and plates

Overlap
successive upper sheets over lower sheets by at least 150mm to shed water
downward

Ensure a sealed still airspace of at least 20mm exists adjacent to
the foil surface

Tape all horizontal and vertical laps with reinforced
aluminum foil tape to form a continuous vapor seal

Seal tightly around all
wall penetrations, window frames, and doors

Cover with external cladding
within manufacturer-specified UV exposure limits
selection_checklist:
Confirm building location is in a warm, humid, or tropical climate zone
(Zones 1-3) where an external vapor barrier is required

Measure total
external wall area allowing for 150mm overlaps (81m² per roll)

Verify
requirement for non-breather impermeable moisture barrier

Order matching 72mm
reinforced aluminum sealing tape
limitations:
Do not use on external
walls in cold climate zones (Zones 6-8) where internal moisture must escape
through breathable wraps
Not designed as primary roof sarking

Must not be
left exposed to continuous outdoor weather without cladding

retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins
Insulation Higgins Foil Non Breather Medium Duty is a solid, unperforated
five-layer reflective foil wall wrap measuring 1350mm x 60m (81 m² per roll).
Engineered with a high-strength woven polypropylene core and a 97% reflective
pure aluminum facing, it functions as an impermeable Class 1/2 vapor barrier and
radiant heat reflector for hot, humid climate zones. Compliant with
AS/NZS 4200.1 and AS 1530 fire standards, it prevents external moisture drive
and draughts from penetrating building frames.
